create_walk_task: create a quadruped walk task environment with a desired walking speed of 0.5 m/s
create_run_task: create a quadruped run task environment with a desired running speed of 5 m/s
create_escape_task: create a quadruped escape task environment where the agent must navigate out of a bowl-shaped terrain
create_fetch_task: create a quadruped fetch task environment where the agent must push a ball to a target
build_quadruped_model: build a MuJoCo XML model for the quadruped with configurable floor size, terrain, rangefinders, and walls
